answer: Each new agent's signing cipher is split into five shares and handed to five established agents picked at random, and each of them may custody only two new shares per epoch. Every payout must be co-signed by three custodians through a private inlet, and they quietly whisper-check that the agent's job history is real before signing. A farm of 300 clones needs 1,500 custody slots from strangers it cannot choose, and any custodian caught approving fakes loses its bond.
